text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2021 tree-cover loss was illegal.**

About 81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss were mapped within the property. Of that area, 68.1 hectares were mapped as planted pine forest, 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest, and none was mapped as native forest.

Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish deforestation, the cause of the change, or whether it was authorized. Determining legality would require information such as applicable rules and permits.
